stem:
A store manager analyzed the change in sales of various products from last month to this month. The percent increases and decreases in sales are shown in the table.

Changes in Sales

| Product | Change in Sales (%) |
|---------|---------------------|
| Watches | -0.3                |
| Ties    | 3                   |
| Shoes   | 2.91                |
| Shirts  | -0.9                |
| Pants   | -1.01               |

These values will be ordered from greatest to least. Which list of the products matches this order?
visual_elements: Table with columns Product and Change in Sales (%), showing Watches -0.3, Ties 3, Shoes 2.91, Shirts -0.9, Pants -1.01
